description_en: Associates an SSL certificate with the forwarding rule of a website
description_zh: 为网站业务转发规则关联SSL证书
name: AssociateWebCert

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the certificate.

> If you specify a certificate ID, you do not need to specify a value for the CertName, Cert, and Key parameters. You can specify only one of this parameter and the CertIdentifier parameter
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID。
> 传入证书ID后，无需传入CertName、Cert和Key。不能与CertIdentifier同时传入
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the certificate.

> You can specify the name of the certificate that you want to associate. This parameter must be used together with the Cert and Key parameters
parameters.help_zh:
证书名称。 

> 要关联的证书名称。该参数必须与Cert和Key一同使用
parameters.name: cert_name

parameters.help_en:
The public key of the certificate that you want to associate. This parameter must be used together with the CertName and Key parameters.

> If you specify a value for the CertName, Cert, and Key parameters, you do not need to specify a value for the CertId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要关联的证书公钥。该参数必须与CertName和Key一同使用。 

> 传入CertName、Cert和Key后，无需传入CertId
parameters.name: cert

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the certificate that you want to associate. This parameter must be used together with the CertName and Cert parameters.

> If you specify a value for the CertName, Cert, and Key parameters, you do not need to specify a value for the CertId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要关联的证书私钥。该参数必须与CertName和Cert一同使用。 

> 传入CertName、Cert和Key后，无需传入CertId
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The globally unique ID of the certificate. The value is in the "Certificate ID-cn-hangzhou" format. For example, if the ID of the certificate is 123, the value of the CertIdentifier parameter is 123-cn-hangzhou.

> You can specify only one of this parameter and the CertId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
全局证书ID，证书ID+"-cn-hangzhou"。如果证书ID=123，则CertIdentifier=“123-cn-hangzhou”。
> 不能与CertId同时传入
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en: The region of the certificate. Valid values: **cn-hangzhou** and **ap-southeast-1**. Default value: **cn-hangzhou**
parameters.name: cert_region
